title: Talk to support
summary: Opens the user's chat with Suporte Bipe (ADR 0114). The API makes the room on first use and invites the user; the app joins it when needed and opens it in chat-timeline.

phase.description: opening: POST /v1/me/support and the join run. failed: see error.

open.effect: From the support row in Ajuda e sobre. POST /v1/me/support gives room_id. If Client.getRoom gives no room or Room.membership is not joined, Client.joinRoomById. Then opens chat-timeline on that room. 503 support_unavailable and other errors: failed with bipe_support_open_failed.

notes: One support room per user. Later calls return the same room and invite the user again after a leave (api/openapi.yaml /v1/me/support). Only one open runs at a time.

The chat list and the timeline show the room with the name bipe_support_room_name and the support account's display name. The room topic (bipe_support_room_topic) says that the team reads the room in a support tool and that photos and files stay on the Bipe server; the bot posts bipe_support_welcome the first time.

Texts in the room go to the Bipe team's Starlings workspace (Cloudflare, outside Brazil). Images and files stay on the Bipe server (ADR 0114, product/privacy.json). Problem reports post a notice into the same room (problem-report).
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.supportRoomID (BipeKit); BipeSupportChat.open (libraries/bipe support), which does the same steps.
